slots.node01.body.item02.p: Governed retrieval connects the foundation to bounded work.
slots.node01.label: Shared foundation
slots.node05.text: Retrieve process, rules, requirements and open questions for a bounded design, coding, testing or cutover task.
slots.node07.text: Warmer handoffs, faster prototyping, stronger traceability and earlier visibility of gaps.
slots.node11.text: Connect bug reports and change requests to documented intent, architecture and tests for impact analysis.
slots.node13.text: Faster investigation, better knowledge preservation and less maintenance effort over time.
slots.node14.text: The context layer compounds in value only while teams keep it current, governed and source-linked.
slots.title: Shared context supports both [[Build and Sustain]]
